response: Gastric electrical stimulation (GES) is indeed superior to standard pharmacologic therapy in improving gastrointestinal (GI) symptoms, reducing the use of healthcare resources, and providing long-term healthcare benefits. According to the available data, GES has been shown to be more effective in improving long-term GI symptoms and costs, and decreasing the use of healthcare resources, compared to intensive medical therapy, in patients with symptoms of gastroparesis (GP) followed for 3 years. This suggests that GES can be a valuable treatment option for patients with GP, offering improved symptom management and reduced healthcare utilization.
